gui.adrenaline.config.title: Adrenaline
gui.adrenaline.warning.not_local_world: This is not a local world; changes will not affect anything.
gui.adrenaline.warning.lan_world: This world is open to LAN; changes may not affect the current session.
gui.adrenaline.warning.restart: Restart or re-enter the world for the safest results.
gui.adrenaline.compat.title: Adrenaline Compatibility
gui.adrenaline.compat.modernfix.line1: ModernFix has chunk and worldgen patches enabled that conflict with Adrenaline.
gui.adrenaline.compat.modernfix.line2: Adrenaline can disable the overlapping ModernFix mixins for you.
gui.adrenaline.compat.modernfix.line3: Press Fix and Restart, then launch the game again.
gui.adrenaline.compat.fastload.line1: Fastload overlaps Adrenaline's startup loading optimizations.
gui.adrenaline.compat.fastload.line2: Adrenaline already provides spawn and startup loading tuning in its settings.
gui.adrenaline.dev_build_warning: You are running a dev build; consider downloading the production version.
gui.adrenaline.enter_early: Shut up and let me in
tooltip.adrenaline.config.serialization_: Controls parallel chunk save encoding workers.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.spawn_zone_rad: Changes the chunk radius generated around spawn.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.worldgen_optim: Master switch for Adrenaline world generation changes.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallel_world: Runs chunk generation work on the generation pool.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.prioritize_hig: Runs the highest available chunk stage first, such as Full or Light.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.terrain_fill_o: Speeds up block filling during noise terrain generation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.surface_optimi: Speeds up surface rule evaluation and block placement.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.noise_chunk_op: Optimizes hot paths inside noise chunk sampling.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.material_rule_: Reduces overhead in material rule dispatch.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.aquifer_optimi: Reduces aquifer lookup and fluid decision cost.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.beardifier_opt: Speeds up structure terrain blending calculations.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.ore_vein_optim: Speeds up ore vein sampling during generation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.initial_spawn_: Skips vanilla's slow initial spawn refinement and jumps directly into normal start-region generation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.feature_safety: Reserves nearby chunks during feature generation. Increase this for mods with features extending beyond adjacent chunks.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.stage_parallel: Controls whether the %s stage is redirected to Adrenaline's parallel scheduler.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.fast_legacy_ra: Replaces legacy random with a faster implementation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.show_cancel_bu: Shows the cancel button during initial world generation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.show_thread_vi: Shows generation worker activity during initial world generation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.start_beforeha: Shows a button that enters the world after the first full chunk is ready.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.debug_logging: Logs extra Adrenaline diagnostics to the console.
